# Equipment checklist

Everything below is implied by a shot in the plan. The lens and camera-height groups are the
ones the ordering actually batches by, so a missing one is a whole block of the session you
cannot shoot.

- [ ] Phone with a locked-exposure camera app and these lenses: **macro, main, tele**
- [ ] Overhead mount or copy stand that holds the phone still and level
- [ ] Camera positions needed: handheld, handheld_free, handheld_grazing_surface, handheld_macro_close, handheld_oblique, handheld_raking_30, mount_grazing_table, mount_low_macro, mount_macro_fov120, mount_macro_fov150_tex, mount_macro_fov200, mount_mid_overhead_hem, mount_overhead, mount_overhead_fov350, mount_overhead_fov550, mount_overhead_locked, oblique_station_30deg
- [ ] Printed ChArUco board, **8 x 11 squares at 25.0 mm**, printed at 100% scale (no 'fit to page'), mounted flat and rigid
- [ ] Steel rule with millimetre graduations, for verifying the printed board
- [ ] A second rule or loop tape that can lie flat beside a hem
- [ ] Tape measure for the garment measurements
- [ ] Vernier or dial caliper for fabric thickness
- [ ] Kitchen scale reading to 1 g for garment and offcut mass
- [ ] Matte, non-reflective backdrop, dark and saturated (a dark green works; light-wash denim on a light backdrop is hard to segment)
- [ ] Two diffuse lights at about 45 degrees
- [ ] Grey or white reference card
- [ ] Fabric shears, sharp, and a straightedge long enough to span a leg
- [ ] Tailor's chalk or a fine marker that will not bleed
- [ ] Two labels for the offcuts, written before cutting
- [ ] A second person available for the cut-mark verification
- [ ] A way to block daylight, or a room without it
